verdict.stance: Constructive / Upgraded to BB by Fitch Post-2030 Eurobond Refinancing
verdict.summary: UzAuto Motors is Uzbekistan's dominant automotive manufacturer (~400k vehicles sold in FY25; $4.1bn revenue, $355m Fitch EBITDA). Fitch upgraded UzAuto to 'BB' Stable (from BB-) after it placed $350m 7.375% Nov-2030 Eurobonds (XS3187746097) to retire its $300m May-2026 maturity and local bank debt, leaving low ~1.2x net leverage.

positives: Eliminated 2026 refinancing wall via $350m 7.375% Nov-2030 Eurobond (XS3187746097), earning Fitch upgrade to BB.
Dominant domestic market position in Uzbekistan with ~400k unit scale ($4.1bn revenue) and ~1.2x net leverage.
Cash doubled to $89.5m at YE25 alongside strong state-owned strategic parentage.
negatives: Reliance on General Motors CKD kit licensing and tariff protection, which faces gradual WTO/EV competition.
Thin ~8.7% EBITDA margin vulnerable to UZS FX depreciation and imported component costs.
Working capital and supplier-payable swings around model transitions.

background.business_overview: Leading Central Asian automotive OEM assembling Chevrolet-branded passenger vehicles in Asaka and Pitnak.
background.asset_perimeter: Asaka assembly plant, Khorezm (Pitnak) plant, and Uzbekistan distribution network.
background.ownership_governance: State-owned via JSC Uzavtosanoat (Republic of Uzbekistan).

recent_drivers: FY25: Sold ~400k vehicles, revenue $4.1bn, Fitch EBITDA $355m, cash $89.5m (vs $42.8m YE24).
Refinancing & Upgrade: Placed $350m 7.375% Nov-30 Eurobond (XS3187746097) to retire May-26 $300m notes; Fitch upgraded to BB Stable.

catalysts.impact: Tests margin resilience amid EV imports (BYD competition).
